head: codex/258-authority-store-boundary
title: [v0.92][runtime][authority] Seal #203 authority store boundary
body:
Closes #258

## Summary
- seal raw certificate, lease, and fencing store access behind explicit authority/test access tokens
- add the governed authority store adapter facade and published receipt view metadata for the #258 slice
- map certificate_activate, certificate_revoke, lease_apply, lease_mutation, fencing_commit, and fencing_active_lease into published-view action classes
- add a positive proof that published_view exposes lineage, operation, action class, adapter metadata, generation, receipt digest, and result digest for all in-scope store operation kinds
- update focused runtime tests and compile-required fixture callers without absorbing #203 sibling transport or migration scope
